designs.title: Pisa
designs.why: Instantly reads as a charming travel stamp of the Leaning Tower; crisp, clean linework with nice detail (arcades, diamond inlays, brick base) and the postmark with wavy cancel lines sells the idea. Works on both white and black tees. But it is a fairly small, quiet print on the back for $50, and the "3.97°" in the corner reads at first glance like a $3.97 price tag, which is a bit odd on a premium shirt until you get the tilt-angle joke.
designs.fix: Make the 3.97° unmistakably the tilt angle (e.g. small "TILT" label or a little angle arc next to it) so it lands as a clever detail instead of looking like a price; slightly enlarging the print would also help it feel worth $50.
